plVersion.description: PrairieLearn version to validate against: "latest", a date (YYYY-MM-DD, the state of PrairieLearn's master that day), or a 40-character commit sha.

schemaCacheDir.description: Directory for downloaded PrairieLearn schemas, relative to this file.

rules.description: Turn rules off or change their severity, by rule id.

ignoredDiagnostics.description: Diagnostic violations to suppress. Uses a semantic identifier when the rule provides one, otherwise an exact message and occurrence. Use the VS Code quick fix to add entries.

file.description: File containing the diagnostic, relative to this config file.

identifier.description: Stable semantic identity of the violation, such as a question id, tag name, or assessment-set name.

message.description: Exact diagnostic message to suppress when the rule has no semantic identifier.

occurrence.description: 1-based occurrence among diagnostics in the file with this rule and message.

unusedQuestions.description: Severity of the diagnostic on a question's info.json title when no assessment uses the question. Shorthand for rules["unused-question"], with "ignored" for "off".

unusedTags.description: Severity of the diagnostic on a tag's name in infoCourse.json when no question uses the tag. Shorthand for rules["unused-tag"], with "ignored" for "off".

unusedAssessmentSets.description: Severity of the diagnostic on an assessment set's name in infoCourse.json when no assessment uses the set. Shorthand for rules["unused-assessment-set"], with "ignored" for "off".

missingQuestionInfo.description: Severity of the diagnostic for a directory in questions/ with files but no info.json (and no question below it), which PrairieLearn fails to load from disk. Shorthand for rules["question-info-missing"], with "ignored" for "off".

excludes.description: Glob patterns of files never to check, relative to this file, e.g. "courseInstances/Archive/**".
